entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' or 'Sales' to be routed to the correct department.
Support.
Connecting you to a VeloFit support agent now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit support. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David, I'm calling because I need to return a VeloBand GPS Tracker I bought back in December.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your name and the order number, please?
Yes, the name is Sarah Jenkins, and the order number is... VF886-1215-25.

Thank you, Sarah. I see the order here, delivered on December 15th. To get started, could you tell me a bit more about the reason for the return? Is it a technical fault with the band, or more of a personal preference?
It's more of a preference, I suppose. Honestly, it's just been a chaotic month. My husband had a medical emergency right after Christmas and ended up in the hospital. It was completely unexpected.
Oh, I'm very sorry to hear that. I hope he's recovering well.

Thank you. He is, but it required an urgent surgery. And to top it all off, his military deployment was moved up, so I was handling all of that on my own. I completely missed what I thought was the return window.
I can absolutely understand how something like a return would fall by the wayside with everything you've been dealing with. Let me just check the policy for you... one moment.
I'd appreciate it. If a full refund isn't possible, maybe some store credit? I just feel bad having it sit here unused.
Okay, Sarah, I've pulled up the information. It looks like you have nothing to worry about. Your purchase is from about 40 days ago, and our policy allows for returns within 10 days of delivery.
Oh! Really? Ninety days? That's a huge relief. I must have misread the policy online.

No problem at all, we're happy to take it back. You are well within the timeframe. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending a pre-paid shipping label to the email on file now. You should see it in the next few minutes.
That's fantastic. I really appreciate your help, David. You've made this very easy.

It's my pleasure, Sarah. Once we receive the item, you'll see a full refund processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope things get less chaotic for you soon. Have a good day.
